'''Bekbek root''' was a starchy, [[Color/Legends|red]] edible root served during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The root could be used as an ingredient in [[braised scyk belly]].<ref name="Scyk" />
